authority: CLAUDE.md §9.4 (durable decision), §12.2 (status vocabulary), §12.3 (contradiction resolution). Operator instruction of 2026-08-29 following the gate_10b failure.
title: Correction of two mis-provenanced claims in the Impact 2.2 draft that blocked gate_10b/g09b_p07

trigger.reason: validation_status.overall_status was 'unresolved'; two claims in section_drafts/impact/2.2.draft.json carried status 'unresolved' with coined claim_ids that no working_assumptions.json declaration key or checklist_ref could resolve, so runner/assumption_applier.py could not flip them.
trigger.note: The node body completed normally. The failure was an honest gate block, not an effect of the operator's machine freeze during the run.

corrections.claim: c14 — 'The M25-M30 placement is supervised by Miklós Maróti and the fellow works with the AgroVIR product development team responsible for the FMIS platform.'
corrections.prior: claim_id 'c14', status 'unresolved', source_ref working_assumptions.json. The coined id matched no declaration, so the applier's flip never fired.
corrections.new: claim_id re-keyed to 'placement_supervisor_AgroVIR'; status left 'unresolved' so the assumption-applier flips it to 'assumed' pre-assembly with the operator's own declared wording.
corrections.why: Both underlying facts are operator declarations, not evidence: placement_supervisor_AgroVIR is operator-supplied ('the Pack asks AgroVIR to confirm the supervision arrangement in writing') and placement_team_AgroVIR is an authorised placeholder registered in working_assumptions.json _operator_placeholders. Marking the claim Confirmed would have asserted a partner confirmation the repository's own record says has not been filed (§12.3), and no deterministic predicate would have caught it — g09b_p13 (declared_facts_are_not_inferred) fires only on 'inferred'.
corrections.team_half: Not lost: the AgroVIR product-development-team fact is separately carried in the same draft as the declared claim 'placement_team_AgroVIR' (already Assumed). The composite c14 was redundant.

corrections.claim: c16 — 'IP strategy separates rights layers: DrR background, FIELDWISE foreground, institutional datasets and Krumatic-developed code, each documented before the action starts.'
corrections.new: status 'confirmed', source_ref re-pointed to docs/tier3_project_instantiation/source_materials/consolidated_pack_2026-08-28/FIELDWISE_Consolidated_Partner_Review_Pack_2026-08-28.extracted.txt (added to the draft's source_refs as tier 3).
corrections.why: The claim was mis-sourced, not undeclared. The consolidated pack states it directly at line 74 ('Pre-MSCA DrR background, FIELDWISE scientific foreground, institutional datasets and Krumatic-developed code must be treated as separate rights layers ... ownership and permitted use should be documented explicitly before the action starts') and again in Appendix A at line 404. It is carried into architecture_inputs/impacts.json:34, project_brief/strategic_positioning.md:82 and phase6_implementation_architecture/implementation_architecture.json:47,239. A named Tier 3 source evidences it directly, which is Confirmed under §12.2. Leaving working_assumptions.json as the source_ref of a Confirmed claim would have been self-contradictory: a declaration is adopted in the absence of evidence and can never confirm.

expected_effect.assumption_applier: flips placement_supervisor_AgroVIR unresolved -> assumed and re-derives section_spine.overall_status
expected_effect.section_overall_status: assumed (verified by read-only simulation over all three impact drafts, 2026-08-29)
expected_effect.g09b_p12: unaffected — the applier normalises claim_id to the declaration key and claim_summary to the declared value, which is exactly what W1 checks

open_item.what: AgroVIR's written confirmation of the M25-M30 supervision arrangement exists per the operator (2026-08-29) but is not yet filed in the repository.
open_item.action_when_filed: File it under docs/tier3_project_instantiation/source_materials/, retire placement_supervisor_AgroVIR (and placement_team_AgroVIR if the letter covers the team) into working_assumptions.json _superseded_and_removed, record the evidence on the VALIDATION_PARTNER record, then the claim may be promoted from Assumed to Confirmed citing that source.
open_item.status_until_then: Assumed — a conscious, operator-owned green (mode β), not a fabricated Confirmed.
